mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts signals rising residential investment and consumer confidence, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly employment growth and decrease in unemployment rate signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.1% fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a 0.5% decline in INDPRO over 3 months fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPI reading exceeds 2.5%, it indicates persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals strengthening labor market conditions that increase household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE declines by at least 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and residential mortgage credit signals robust consumer demand for housing and associated spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST growth > 1% and RSAFS growth > 0.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index falls below 105, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 105.
